Sara (People Ops): Hey team — dropping the Manager/HR onboarding checklist template I want us to use for new hires starting next week. Can folks skim and shout if anything major is missing? :wave:

Sara (People Ops): TL;DR: includes a first-week agenda, suggested 30/60/90 goals template for managers, and HR expectations (paperwork, benefits, buddy). Paste below.

Sara (People Ops): ```
First-week agenda (high level):
- Day 0: Equipment delivered + account invites (IT)
- Day 1: Welcome + people-ops intro (9am), benefits + payroll (10am), team kickoff + manager 1:1 (2pm)
- Day 2: Product overview + tech stack walkthrough
- Day 3: Security & compliance training + infra access
- Day 4: Team onboarding tasks + first small PR/code task
- Day 5: Check-in with manager + set 30/60/90 goals

30/60/90 template for manager to fill:
- 30 days: ramp goals (meet key stakeholders, set dev environment, complete onboarding trainings)
- 60 days: contribute to a milestone, own a small feature/task, feedback checkpoint
- 90 days: independent ownership of an area, measurable impact metric, performance touchpoint

HR expectations: paperwork (I-9, W-4), benefits enrollment window, direct deposit, emergency contact, buddy assignment, ID/access badges.
```

Ben (Eng Manager): This is great, Sara. One quick Q — for the "team kickoff + manager 1:1" slot, can we standardize a template agenda? e.g., 30m team intro, 30m goals chat, 15m OKR alignment.

Sara (People Ops): Yep — love that. Add to the template: "Team kickoff template: intros (10m), team priorities (20m), 1:1 goals (30m), logistics (10m)". I'll update the doc.

Alex (Recruiter): Also recommend adding a reminder to send the new hire a short "how to prep for day 1" email 48 hours before start with links, parking/KMS, and a Slack intro blurb they can share.

Lia (IT Support): For equipment, please confirm shipping address + whether they need a dock or specific monitors. Also: do we want admin access on day 1 or day 2? Security prefers day 2 after MAM enrollment.

Sara (People Ops): Good catch. Let's do device shipped Day 0, MDM & admin access Day 2 after SSO + MFA enrollment. I'll add it.

Ben (Eng Manager): Will schedule the manager 1:1s and block recurring weekly 1:1s in the calendar. Also assigning @Priya a buddy (Maya) — will DM her now.

Priya (New Hire): Thanks! Quick Q — what should I prepare before Day 1? Any pre-reads?

Sara (People Ops): @Priya — we'll send the "prep for day 1" email with 3 short items: 1) org chart + product overview (10 min), 2) list of required trainings (security, privacy), 3) links to codebase readme and the runbook. Nothing heavy.

Ben (Eng Manager): For the 30/60/90, I usually ask engineers to write their own draft by end of week 2 and then we refine together. Adding that to the manager notes.

Lia (IT Support): @Sara — please put the new hire's corporate asset tag and expected delivery window in this doc so we can track. Also putting a note: request VPN + GH access on day 2, create service accounts if needed.

Sara (People Ops): Will add asset tracking and a checkbox table in the doc. Also adding a short HR checklist for benefits enrollment deadlines and probation review timing (60 days perf check in).

onboard-bot: New doc created: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboarding/manager-hr-checklist (link auto-post) :link:

Alex (Recruiter): minor suggestion — include a line about inclusive onboarding (pronouns, accessibility needs, remote timezones).

Sara (People Ops): Absolutely. Adding that to the welcome template and the pre-day-1 email.

Ben (Eng Manager): Everything sounds good. I'll update the team kickoff invite and ping once buddy assigned. :thumbsup:

Priya (New Hire): 🙏 thanks everyone — excited to start!

Sara (People Ops): Thanks team. If no objections I'll close this thread and publish the doc by EOD. :checkered_flag:
